messages:
sara: opened a tiny PR that consolidates streaming retry+digest/dedupe guidance for different error classes (429, stream timeouts, partial chunks). snippets for node/python + a minimal replay harness. PTAL :wave:

josh: link? also want to ensure we call out interactions with context window trimming — users keep asking if they should re-send last 1-2 tokens after resume.

sara: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821. I explicitly recommend an "at-most-once commit" pattern (checkpoint last-committed token id) vs naive resend of tail tokens. included a small node snippet showing a resumable cursor + idempotent tail approach.

kai: can you paste the node snippet here so I can sanity-check style? prefer tiny examples that match our SDK surface.

sara: pasted snippet in PR, but pasted inline here too: ```js
// pseudo-node snippet: resumable stream with cursor
const resp = await client.stream({ prompt, headers: { 'x-stream-cursor': cursor }});
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  if (chunk.cursor <= lastCommitted) continue;
  buffer += chunk.text;
  lastCommitted = chunk.cursor;
}
```

josh: looks good. two doc asks: 1) include a one-line matrix: what 429 means in streaming vs sync, 2) add a note about Dedicated behavior (queueing) and Private (customer-controlled timeouts).

sara: added a compact matrix: 429-sync => request rejected; 429-stream (mid-stream) => service signalled overload, client may receive Retry-After header or stream aborted; server crash => 502/504; client abort => local cancel/499 from proxies. Added bullet on Dedicated vs Private.

kai: small editorial: change header name to code span `x-stream-cursor`. also please add a tiny paragraph where we say "do not double-count tokens when resuming" and point to cost implications.

sara: done both. also added a brief migration note for SDKs that auto-reconnect: "turn off implicit auto-retry for streaming endpoints or switch to resumable semantics".

josh: ops question: if a stream is interrupted and the client retries with the same cursor, what happens with server-side KV cache? does it replay from cache or re-execute? we should mention best-effort caching semantics.

sara: added: servers attempt prefix/KV cache replay when available but cannot guarantee exact token-level dedupe; recommend idempotent tail in prompt to avoid duplication.

tanvi: editorial pass: please add crosslinks to the SDK quickstart and error-ref section, and ensure header casing for `Retry-After`. Also prefer using :warning: for the cost-note.

sara: done. added :warning: about token duplication cost and crosslinks.
